notes.title: ONLY 1 DAY LEFT! GAME RELEASE SCHEDULE 🌍
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/27b9ad62543f47336978072a56216116ce618121.png"]
You won't be able to hide from this release! FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE is coming out tomorrow, and we'll finally have a chance to share the results of our work with you! ❤️


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/"][/dynamiclink]

We know that you, our beloved players, have been waiting for this for a long time. Many of you are from different corners of the world, so we have prepared a release map in different time zones for countries and regions. Explore it carefully and set your alarm clocks so you can be the first to break into dorm life and enjoy all the delights of the school of magic 🔥



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/5197b693658bc04556ea57ce33527fda997c793d.png"]



⏰ When is the release time?

Each region has its own launch time, and we don't want you to guess and figure it out yourself. That's why we've put everything together in a handy image — just find your region and remember the time!

🔹 September 12 

9 AM - Los Angeles

10 AM - Mexico

11 AM - Houston

12 PM - New York

1 PM - Sao Paulo

3 PM - London

6 PM - Varsovia and Cape Town

7 PM - Moscow

8 PM - Dubai

9 PM - Almaty

11 PM - Bangkok and Krasnoyarsk

🔹 September 13

1 AM - Seoul and Tokyo

2 AM - Vladivostok

3 AM - Hong Kong and Sydney

10 AM - Anchorage



💖 Thank you for being with us all this time, for your support, reviews, and help in making the game better. Tomorrow we will finally meet you at FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE — and we promise this adventure will be unforgettable.



In the meantime, get ready, add the game to your wishlists, and charge your magic wands, because tomorrow it all begins for real!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: ✨ Get ready: the official release date of FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE is here
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/c63f1e27d68567266ba05ba3e7ed19383e9f6c6b.png"]


💕 Hey, sweetie!
POV: Your old horny girlfriend has come to visit you! You haven't seen her in six long years.

While our entire dormitory is buzzing and celebrating this great event, our team is preparing for the release to the fullest.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/"][/dynamiclink]
⚡️RELEASE ON SEPTEMBER 12!⚡️
Yes, you read that right! On September 12, you will finally be able to dive into the world of FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE and experience everything we have worked so hard to create for you.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/77c4e91b607fafef6aef5a2148b65b42f664615f.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/471275bf3593d41d475e4853faa1deea0236823a.jpg"]

We can finally say with full confidence: the time has come! Our entire team has been working tirelessly to bring the game as close to perfection as possible and make it exactly what you deserve — passionate, hot, and full of surprises. While you’ve been waiting, we not only fixed bugs, but also added a ton of great new content 💥



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/3e559343bbfb5dc7340f996666b74b858b0e112b.png"]



And as a bonus on release, you'll get this hot Hornet skin for our Bella! 🔥

Add FEMBOY FUTA HOUSE to your wishlist and watch the countdown! Just a little bit left!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3602290/FEMBOY_FUTA_HOUSE/"][/dynamiclink][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45559776/1dc2de08252676e281f4d223dc0e24c8442efe57.png"]
